author: Good Enough
description:
Centuries ago, Europeans believed crushed human remains could cure everything from headaches to stomach pain. This so‑called ‘medicine’ was called Mummia, and yes, it was literally made from real mummies. Quack doctors sold it as a miracle cure, but in reality it was one of history’s strangest medical fads.
